results.name: GEO-97-TC001 Auth0 login resolves organization context
steps: Given an Auth0 test user with valid credentials for organization A
When the user authenticates via Auth0
Then the user can access data scoped to organization A only

results.name: GEO-97-TC002 Missing token returns 401
steps: Given an unauthenticated user requests a protected resource
When the request is sent without a token
Then the system returns 401 Unauthorized

results.name: GEO-97-TC003 Invalid token returns 401
steps: Given a request with an invalid or expired Auth0 token
When the request reaches a protected resource
Then the system returns 401 Unauthorized

results.name: GEO-97-TC004 Reader cannot create reports
steps: Given an authenticated Reader
When they attempt to create a report
Then the system returns 403 Forbidden

results.name: GEO-97-TC005 Reader cannot edit reports
steps: Given an authenticated Reader
When they attempt to edit a report
Then the system returns 403 Forbidden

results.name: GEO-97-TC006 Reader cannot delete reports
steps: Given an authenticated Reader
When they attempt to delete a report
Then the system returns 403 Forbidden

results.name: GEO-96-TC001 Unactivated module redirects to upgrade page
steps: Given an authenticated user belongs to an organization without Mesure
When the user opens the Mesure module
Then the user is redirected to the sales/upgrade page

results.name: GEO-96-TC002 Activated module with no reports shows empty state
steps: Given an authenticated user belongs to an organization with Mesure activated and no reports
When the user opens the Mesure module
Then an empty state with illustration and Create Report CTA is shown

results.name: GEO-96-TC003 Activated module with reports shows list
steps: Given an authenticated user belongs to an organization with Mesure activated and existing reports
When the user opens the Mesure module
Then the report list is displayed

results.name: GEO-95-TC001 Core report fields are displayed
steps: Given an authenticated Editor with existing reports in organization A
When the report list is opened
Then each report displays its name, status badge, creation date, number of markets, and number of categories

results.name: GEO-95-TC002 Status badges are displayed correctly
steps: Given an authenticated Editor has one PENDING report and one CONFIGURED report
When the report list is opened
Then each report shows the correct status badge

results.name: GEO-95-TC003 Most recent reports appear first
steps: Given an authenticated Editor has reports created on different dates
When the report list is opened
Then the newest report appears first

results.name: GEO-95-TC004 Sorting changes report order
steps: Given an authenticated Editor has multiple reports and sorting controls are available
When the user sorts the list by creation date ascending
Then the reports are reordered according to the selected sort

results.name: GEO-95-TC005 Filtering narrows visible reports
steps: Given an authenticated Editor has multiple reports and filtering controls are available
When the user applies a valid filter, such as status PENDING
Then only reports matching the filter are displayed

results.name: GEO-95-TC006 Pagination shows the requested page
steps: Given an authenticated Editor has more reports than fit on one page
When the user navigates to the next page of the list
Then only the reports for that page are displayed

results.name: GEO-95-TC007 List loads within one second
steps: Given an authenticated Editor has existing reports in a standard dataset
When the report list is opened
Then the list is fully rendered within 1 second

results.name: GEO-95-TC008 Reader sees read-only report list
steps: Given an authenticated Reader with existing reports is available
When the report list is opened
Then no create, edit, or delete actions are available

results.name: GEO-95-TC009 Organization A only sees its own reports
steps: Given an authenticated user belongs to organization A with reports in organizations A and B
When the report list is opened
Then only organization A reports are displayed
